INDOMITABLESPIRE2-HYDRANGEA_TEA_PARTY.pa:
The clamor of the Spire fades into a sea of blooming [blue]hydrangeas[/blue]. You yawn. Surely there is a quiet corner here for a [sine]long, comfortable nap[/sine].

But in the pavilion among the flowers, your three sisters have already laid out tea and pastries.
[blue]Illustrious[/blue] waves with a gentle smile. [gold]Victorious[/gold] raises her teacup and calls your name. [purple]Formidable[/purple] sits perfectly upright, her gaze putting an end to any thoughts of slipping away.

Your plans to slack off will have to wait. Whose invitation will you accept?

You settle beside Illustrious. She pours you a cup of tea, and its warm fragrance eases the tension from your shoulders.

[blue]“May the light of love and peace always protect you, my dear sister.”[/blue]

She places two potions beside your saucer and invites you to take one. Of course she has thought of your safety on the road, too.

You have barely sat down when Victorious claps you on the shoulder and slides a cup of her special blend across the table. Her enthusiasm is almost blinding. Even your drowsiness begins to fade.

[gold]“However strong the enemy, set sail with victory in your heart! Cheers!”[/gold]

After clinking cups, she produces two potions. It seems you must choose something from her collection to help you on your way.

You quietly take the seat opposite Formidable. She lifts her teacup with a gracious nod, as though you had never considered sneaking away.

[purple]“Now that you are here, do enjoy this little moment of peace. And mind your manners.”[/purple]

Two potions stand beside the pastries. One brings dangerous flames to mind; the other promises [sine]deep, dreamless sleep[/sine]. Formidable nudges them toward you and waits for your choice.

The teacups are empty. All too soon, it is time to leave.

You tuck away your gifts and cast a longing glance at the hydrangeas. Such a lovely place for a nap... but the Spire still awaits.

With a lazy stretch and your sisters' blessings, you reluctantly continue your journey.
[sine]You can always sleep when you get back...[/sine]
